description: Image telemetry from the img monitor (TASK-157): frames, JPEG throughput, frame age, drops per device; monitor and ffmpeg CPU/RSS and load per core per host. Buckets of 60 s, kept 7 days. Needs IMG_TELEMETRY=true on the host.

panels.title: Frames arrived per second (monitor view)

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_start AS time, host_name || ' / ' || device_id AS metric, AVG(arrived_fps::float) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM image_telemetry_buckets /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_id = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR (device_id = '_host' AND host_name = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT split_part(k, ':', 1) FROM unnest(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) AS k))))) image_telemetry_buckets WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND host_name IN (${host:sqlstring}) AND device_id <> '_host' AND arrived_fps IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Frames the img monitor saw per second, counted before its drain. This is the capture rate seen by the monitor, not the stream FPS.

panels.title: Image throughput (JPEG on disk)

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_start AS time, host_name || ' / ' || device_id AS metric, AVG(estimated_image_throughput_bps::float) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM image_telemetry_buckets /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_id = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR (device_id = '_host' AND host_name = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT split_part(k, ':', 1) FROM unnest(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) AS k))))) image_telemetry_buckets WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND host_name IN (${host:sqlstring}) AND device_id <> '_host' AND estimated_image_throughput_bps IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Estimated image throughput: sum of JPEG bytes x 8 / window. Not the ffmpeg stream bitrate and not network.

panels.title: Frame age p95 when analysed

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_start AS time, host_name || ' / ' || device_id AS metric, AVG(frame_age_p95_ms::float) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM image_telemetry_buckets /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_id = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR (device_id = '_host' AND host_name = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT split_part(k, ':', 1) FROM unnest(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) AS k))))) image_telemetry_buckets WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND host_name IN (${host:sqlstring}) AND device_id <> '_host' AND frame_age_p95_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: How old a frame is when the monitor starts on it (upper bound of the p95 histogram bucket). Rising = the monitor is behind.

panels.title: Frames dropped (drained or skipped)

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_start AS time, host_name || ' / ' || device_id AS metric, SUM(frames_dropped::float) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM image_telemetry_buckets /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_id = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR (device_id = '_host' AND host_name = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT split_part(k, ':', 1) FROM unnest(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) AS k))))) image_telemetry_buckets WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND host_name IN (${host:sqlstring}) AND device_id <> '_host' AND frames_dropped IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Frames the monitor discarded to stay on the newest one. A few per window is normal under load; a steady stream means the monitor is saturated.

panels.title: Monitor CPU / ffmpeg CPU (% of one core)

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_start AS time, host_name || ' monitor' AS metric, cpu_pct_monitor::float AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM image_telemetry_buckets /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_id = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR (device_id = '_host' AND host_name = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT split_part(k, ':', 1) FROM unnest(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) AS k))))) image_telemetry_buckets WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND host_name IN (${host:sqlstring}) AND device_id = '_host' AND cpu_pct_monitor IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT bucket_start, host_name || ' ffmpeg', cpu_pct_ffmpeg::float FROM (SELECT * FROM image_telemetry_buckets /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_id = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR (device_id = '_host' AND host_name = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT split_part(k, ':', 1) FROM unnest(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) AS k))))) image_telemetry_buckets WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND host_name IN (${host:sqlstring}) AND device_id = '_host' AND cpu_pct_ffmpeg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Monitor / ffmpeg RSS

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_start AS time, host_name || ' monitor' AS metric, rss_monitor_bytes::float AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM image_telemetry_buckets /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_id = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR (device_id = '_host' AND host_name = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT split_part(k, ':', 1) FROM unnest(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) AS k))))) image_telemetry_buckets WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND host_name IN (${host:sqlstring}) AND device_id = '_host' AND rss_monitor_bytes IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT bucket_start, host_name || ' ffmpeg', rss_ffmpeg_bytes::float FROM (SELECT * FROM image_telemetry_buckets /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_id = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR (device_id = '_host' AND host_name = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT split_part(k, ':', 1) FROM unnest(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) AS k))))) image_telemetry_buckets WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND host_name IN (${host:sqlstring}) AND device_id = '_host' AND rss_ffmpeg_bytes IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.description: A monitor RSS that only climbs over days is a leak (BUG-0095, BUG-0474 shape).

panels.title: Load per core (1 min)

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_start AS time, host_name AS metric, load_per_core::float AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM image_telemetry_buckets /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_id = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR (device_id = '_host' AND host_name = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT split_part(k, ':', 1) FROM unnest(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) AS k))))) image_telemetry_buckets WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND host_name IN (${host:sqlstring}) AND device_id = '_host' AND load_per_core IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.description: 1-minute load average divided by logical CPU count. About 1 = full. Empty on Windows.

panels.title: Queue depth max and DB samples dropped

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_start AS time, host_name || ' / ' || device_id || ' queue' AS metric, queue_depth_max::float AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM image_telemetry_buckets /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_id = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR (device_id = '_host' AND host_name = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT split_part(k, ':', 1) FROM unnest(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) AS k))))) image_telemetry_buckets WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND host_name IN (${host:sqlstring}) AND device_id <> '_host' UNION ALL SELECT bucket_start, host_name || ' telemetry rows dropped', samples_dropped::float FROM (SELECT * FROM image_telemetry_buckets /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_id = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR (device_id = '_host' AND host_name = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT split_part(k, ':', 1) FROM unnest(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) AS k))))) image_telemetry_buckets WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND host_name IN (${host:sqlstring}) AND device_id = '_host' ORDER BY 1

SELECT DISTINCT ON (host_name, device_id) host_name AS "Host", device_id AS "Device", bucket_start AS "Bucket", arrived_fps AS "fps in", ROUND(estimated_image_throughput_bps/1000.0) AS "kbps (JPEG)", frame_age_p95_ms AS "age p95 ms", frames_dropped AS "dropped", image_bytes AS "bytes" FROM (SELECT * FROM image_telemetry_buckets /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_id = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR (device_id = '_host' AND host_name = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT split_part(k, ':', 1) FROM unnest(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) AS k))))) image_telemetry_buckets WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND host_name IN (${host:sqlstring}) AND device_id <> '_host' ORDER BY host_name, device_id, bucket_start DESC
